verdict.rationale: Sardine's docs say users can be enrolled in ongoing monitoring with alerts if a customer later appears on a watchlist, and that daily OFAC, PEP and adverse-media screening covers existing and new customers. That covers enabling ongoing screening per customer. Nothing in the pack shows unenrolling or disabling it for selected customers, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented ability to disable or unenroll ongoing screening per customer, a description of the enrollment mechanism (dashboard or API), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
